page: Amazon Web Services m8gd.12xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by AWS Graviton processors. It features 48 dedicated physical cores built on the ARM64 architecture, specifically utilizing the ARMv9 Neoverse-V2 model running at 2.8 GHz. The processor includes a 64 KB L1d cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 36 MB L3 cache, with hardware support for AES cryptography. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance includes 2850 GB of local NVMe SSD instance store storage, offering high-speed local data access directly attached via the Nitro hypervisor. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 22 Gbps. The absence of a dedicated GPU makes this server type tailored strictly for CPU-driven workloads.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance in memory bandwidth, with read-only and write large-block operations ranking in the top 10%. Multi-core processing is strong, as evidenced by top-tier results in Geekbench multi-core tests and software compilation with Clang. Passmark database operations and static web serving throughput also rank in the top 10%. These characteristics make the instance highly efficient for database operations, static web serving, software compilation, and Redis caching, offering a balanced resource density for general-purpose enterprise applications.
